notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes: This update adds the dining area of space station. It is currently empty with not much to really look at but the overall general layout is there. This update also introduces a weapon inventory system. I have decided to give players up to 4 weapon slots. Two ranged weapons and two melee weapons. I have also replaced the old pistol model with a new one as well changed out the sound as many people have stated the old sound hurt peoples ears. I have also added a weapon icon as well as an ammo system with reloading and ammo tracking. Guards can now aim up and down at the player and the Warden enemy type had its behavior adjusted. Previously it would start a chase but then almost immediately give up.

notes.title: Environment, Multiplayer and Health system Update
notes.notes: This update fixes a few more issues with the multiplayer. It is still not fully ready for release however it is playable with the ability to invite friends and join public lobbies. (Still testing functionality). There is now a new health screen which updates based on your current health. I have also added a medkit which restores health completely. I will soon be adding crafted medkits which will restore a portion of your health. Lastly I have expanded a little bit on the environment giving it more depth and purpose.

notes.title: Display patch for steam friend list and invite status.
notes.notes: Added patch for friend list displaying empty user slots and duplicate slots.

notes.title: Multiplayer + Game play mechanics patch
notes.notes: Finally got the multiplayer started up. I will be testing with people soon to see if it works and then start polishing off some multiplayer mechanics. This patch also fixes some mechanics that got broken while implementing the multiplayer system. Some mechanics are still broken including the QTE event system. NOTE: There is also a bug with the DLSS settings that cause the terminal screens to turn black. I will be fixing this hopefully within the next few days. Expect big changes to the game map in the next major update probably a few weeks from now!

notes.title: Interaction Guide Update
notes.notes: To help players navigate their tools better, I added in a small pop up window which displays instructions on ways you can interact with items you are using. Also fixed an issue with the enemy high lighting mechanics.
